Sound.// Device: Default routes to the Windows default endpoint (may be a virtual device). Set explicitly to bypass routing. Options from the startup log include: Speakers (Scarlett 2i2 USB)
Sound.// BufferSize: 0=engine default (512). Larger = more latency but fewer realtime glitches. Try 1024/2048/4096.
Sound.// SampleRate: 0=engine default (48000). Set to match your output device's rate to avoid resampling glitches.
